isoscore.note: Verified 2026-06-21: BLME geometry.isotropy._isoscore matches IsoScore.IsoScore to <3e-8 across isotropic/anisotropic/near-1D/N>d clouds. The reference normalizes the covariance spectrum with L2 (torch.linalg.vector_norm), identical to BLME's np.linalg.norm; the AUDIT_V2 'L1-normalizes' lead is refuted by the reference source.

attention_sink_all_queries_to_bos.note: Gu et al. Sink_1: first-token sink fraction over (layer,head). When all queries attend to BOS, every (layer,head) has a first-token sink -> 1.0. Was 0.25 under the old mean-over-all-key-positions reduction; corrected 2026-06-22.

chain_of_embedding_three_points.note: CoE-C uses NORMALIZED magnitude AND NORMALIZED angle, matching reference score.py compute_CoE_C (Alsace08/Chain-of-Embedding). Was 1.118034 (raw/raw) before the 2026-06-22 fix; BLME runs float32 so tol=1e-6.

distinct_n_tokens.note: Distinct-n = distinct n-grams / total tokens (Li 2016). distinct_2 was 0.75 under the old n-gram-count denominator; corrected to 3/5=0.6 on 2026-06-22. distinct_1 unchanged (n=1 identity).

self_bleu_partial_overlap.note: Texygen/NLTK sentence_bleu + SmoothingFunction().method1, weights (1/4,)*4. The old hand-rolled estimator hard-zeroed this (4-gram precision 0). Verified == NLTK 2026-06-22.

persistence_entropy_lifespans.note: Base-2 (matches giotto-tda scipy.stats.entropy base=2 and Atienza Def 3.1). Was 1.0397 under the old natural-log convention; changed by the np.log->np.log2 fix 2026-06-22.

linear_cka_fixed_pair.note: Reference = official google-research cka.feature_space_linear_cka (Kornblith 2019). BLME HSIC form matches to 3e-15; _linear_cka to 1.8e-8 (runs in float32).
